blk_part_06_part_6_the_seville_fair_and_.text: The Seville Fair, also called Feria de Abril, is an Andalusian fair in Seville. It usually begins two weeks after Holy Week, the week before Easter. The fair has rows of decorated tents called casetas. These belong to families, groups of friends, clubs, and other groups. From about nine at night until early morning, people dance sevillanas, a folk dance danced in pairs.

blk_part_06_part_6_the_seville_fair_and_.text: Southern Spain is also the home of flamenco. Flamenco is an Andalusian art of music, song, and dance. The Romani people of Andalusia helped create it. Like Valencian paella, flamenco has a local home, even though people know it far beyond that region.
